columns.QD4: A new, higher-dose regimen of Spinraza was shown to have positive clinical benefits in the DEVOTE trial. The new regimen was recently approved in Japan, but the FDA issued a CRL due to required updates on the CMC module, not the clinical data.
columns.QD5x2: Taldefgrobep alfa is a myostatin inhibitor in a Phase 3 clinical trial as an adjunct to other SMA therapies. Recent results indicated it did not meet its primary  motor function improvement endpoint, but showed clinically meaningful improvements in subgroups and had a positive effect on body composition.
